newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IDT International to list in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: IDT International to list in Singapore.

text.p: Hong Kong-listed electronics manufacturer IDT International Ltd said on Friday shareholders approved a proposal to list on the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
It said it obtained approval at today's special general meeting for a separate listing of its liquid crystal display consumer electronic products business.
This would be done through a new issue and an offer for sale of shares in a company incorporated in Singapore, to be named IDT Holdings (Singapore) Limited.
Pricing and the price/earnings ratio of the separate listing will be announced later, the company said in a statment.
IDT intends to use proceeds from the new issue to expand existing facilities and to increase working capital.
It will also use proceeds from the offer for sale for further development and expansion of its other business, mainly in electronic stationary products and telecommunications.
